T10_faq.h2: MAGLUMI X analyzer questions and answers

items.q: What is the throughput of the MAGLUMI X analyzers?
items.a: A single MAGLUMI X3 module delivers up to 200 tests per hour, X6 up to 450, X8 up to 600, and X10 up to 1,000 tests per hour.

items.q: Which MAGLUMI X models can be combined in a four-module configuration?
items.a: Snibe provides specifications for four-module MAGLUMI X8 and X10 configurations: up to 2,400 and up to 4,000 tests per hour, respectively.

items.q: Where can I browse the MAGLUMI CLIA test menu?
items.a: The dedicated menu page presents 278 parameters, as stated by Snibe, with search by test name.

items.q: Which other MAGLUMI analyzers are presented on the website?
items.a: The MAGLUMI M Series page presents MAGLUMI 600, 800, 2000 and 2000 Plus, each delivering up to 180 tests per hour.

items.q: Who supplies and maintains MAGLUMI analyzers in Ukraine?
items.a: LabWell is an official Snibe distributor in Ukraine. It helps select the most effective solution for your needs and provides supply, installation, staff training, warranty and post-warranty maintenance, and application support.
